question: Which revolutionary along with Batukeshwar Dutt threw bombs in the Central Assembly in 1929?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Bhagat Singh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bhagat Singh** was a prominent Indian revolutionary known for his role in the freedom struggle.
 
• On **April 8, 1929**, Bhagat Singh and **Batukeshwar Dutt** threw bombs in the **Central Legislative Assembly** in Delhi.
 
• The act was aimed at protesting against the repressive **Public Safety Bill** and **Trade Disputes Act** introduced by the British government.
 
• The bombs were intentionally non-lethal, aimed at creating a loud noise to draw attention rather than causing harm.
 
• After throwing the bombs, Bhagat Singh and Dutt surrendered themselves to the British authorities, demonstrating their courage and commitment to the cause.
 
• Their act was followed by the distribution of leaflets emphasizing their message: "**It takes a loud voice to make the deaf hear**."
 
• Bhagat Singh became a symbol of revolutionary nationalism and inspired many young Indians to join the fight for independence.
 
• His ideas were influenced by socialism, and he envisioned an India free from exploitation and inequality.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Chandrashekhar Azad**__

 __
 
• **Chandrashekhar Azad** was another prominent revolutionary who played a crucial role in the Indian freedom struggle.
 
• He was a part of the **Hindustan Socialist Republican Association (HSRA)**, which aimed to fight British imperialism.
 
• Azad is known for his bravery and his resolve to never be captured alive by the British, eventually fulfilling his promise by shooting himself in a confrontation with the police.
 
 
 
• **Ashfaqulla Khan**__
 __
 
• **Ashfaqulla Khan** was another revolutionary who contributed to the freedom struggle.
 
• He was a key member of the **Kakori Conspiracy**, where revolutionaries looted a train carrying British government funds.
 
• He was executed for his role in the conspiracy, becoming a martyr for India’s independence movement.
 
 
 
• **Rajguru**__
 
 
• **Shivaram Rajguru** was a revolutionary who worked closely with Bhagat Singh and Sukhdev.
 
• He played a significant role in the assassination of **John Saunders**, a British officer, to avenge the death of **Lala Lajpat Rai**.
 
• Rajguru was executed alongside Bhagat Singh and Sukhdev on **March 23, 1931**, becoming one of the martyrs of India’s freedom struggle.
